title: Thule Society seances to contact star beings

tellings.quote: The Thule Society held seances and rituals meant to contact non-human intelligences they believed were their ancient progenitors, star beings from the far north, beneath the pole star.

plain: In Germany in the 1910s and 1920s, a secretive group called the Thule Society is said to have held seances and rituals to reach beings who were not human. According to Michels, who tells this himself without naming a source, the members believed these beings were their ancient ancestors: "star beings from the far north, beneath the pole star." Michels brings it up as an example of occult attempts at contact standing behind later history.
